_doc: Shared-library config root. ea_cloud-libs-shared/ holds the modules that several apps compile by reference, so the config those modules read when the CONSUMING app declares none of its own has to live here too - not in one of the consumers. libs/voice/build.gradle reads ${rootDir}/build.json first and falls back to this file; before the modules moved out of ea_cloud-superapp/libs/ that fallback landed on ea_cloud-superapp/build.json, which is exactly the app-is-a-library-for-another-app coupling the move removed. This is NOT an app: no modules, no signing, no workflow.

voice._doc: Offline voice-input (Vosk) model registry for libs:voice, behind the keyboard VOICE toolbar key. libs/voice/build.gradle bakes this into BuildConfig.VOICE_MODELS_JSON + VOICE_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE; VoiceModelManager downloads the model for the active keyboard language lazily on first use, unzips to filesDir/vosk/<dir>, then Vosk runs fully offline (no Google/system speech IME). Add a language = one entry. Small models keep each download ~40-50MB.
